labelChirho: to be like, to be compared to
descriptionChirho: To represent, be like, be compared to -- used in Nifal ('to become like, be likened'), Hifil ('to compare, liken'), and Hitpael ('to make oneself like'). In Ps 49:12,20 'man in his pomp is like (nimshal) the beasts that perish'; Isa 14:10 'you have become like us'; Ps 28:1 'lest I become like those who go down to the pit'; Ps 143:7 'I will be like those who go down to the pit'; Isa 46:5 'to whom will you compare me?'; Job 30:19 'I am likened to dust and ashes.' Multilingual glosses: arb yushbah/mumathil, deu ist-wie, fra comparer, hin tulya/saman (equal/like), kor bigida/biseuthaejida (compare/become similar), spa semejante/comparar.
